personalInfo.name: Hans
personalInfo.title: Cryptography engineer
personalInfo.bio: I'm a cryptography engineer with a networking background, building cross-platform apps with React Native, Expo and TypeScript. I like understanding how things work end to end, from the network up to the app in your hand, and I'm growing toward DevOps and infrastructure. Let's connect and build something together.

projects.title: Capto Web App
projects.description: Web app for Capto, a voice-first platform for tradespeople in France. Users record a voice note and AI turns it into a quote or invoice, with automation for missed calls.

keyResponsibilities: Contribute to the cross-platform web app for a voice-first SaaS product that turns tradespeople's voice notes into quotes and invoices.
Set up and maintain the React JS
Research Twilio integration for automated missed-call handling.
Collaborate in a team with parallel workstreams, sprint planning and CI/CD pipelines.
